result.markdown: --- title: "[Graph.add_star_graph()]{.doc-object-name .doc-function .doc-label .doc-label-method}" body-classes: doc-api-page page-navigation: false html-table-processing: none --- ::: {.doc-subject} Add a star graph (hub-and-spoke) to the current graph. ::: ::: {.doc-usage-source} Usage [Source](https://github.com/rich-iannone/edgecase/blob/main/python/edgecase/graph.py#L1896-L1965){target="_blank" rel="noopener"} ::: ::: {.doc-signature .doc-Kind.FUNCTION} ```python Graph.add_star_graph(n, type=None, label=True, rel=None) ``` ::: ::: {.doc-text} Creates a central hub node connected to `n - 1` peripheral nodes. All edges connect the hub to spokes; no edges between spokes. ::: ## Parameters {.doc-parameters} ::: {.doc-definition-items} [n]{.doc-parameter-name}[:]{.doc-parameter-annotation-sep} [int]{.doc-parameter-annotation} : Total number of nodes (minimum `2`). [type]{.doc-parameter-name}[:]{.doc-parameter-annotation-sep} [Optional[str]]{.doc-parameter-annotation} [=]{.doc-parameter-default-sep .op} [None]{.doc-parameter-default} : Optional node type/category for all nodes. [label]{.doc-parameter-name}[:]{.doc-parameter-annotation-sep} [bool]{.doc-parameter-annotation} [=]{.doc-parameter-default-sep .op} [[True]{.va}]{.doc-parameter-default} : If `True`, label nodes with their IDs. [rel]{.doc-parameter-name}[:]{.doc-parameter-annotation-sep} [Optional[str]]{.doc-parameter-annotation} [=]{.doc-parameter-default-sep .op} [None]{.doc-parameter-default} : Optional relationship label for all edges. ::: ## Returns {.doc-returns} ::: {.doc-definition-items} [Graph]{.doc-parameter-annotation} : Self for method chaining. ::: ## Examples {.doc-examples} Create a star graph: ::: {#09c68f43 .cell execution_count=1} ``` {.python .cell-code} import edgecase as ec graph = ec.Graph().add_star_graph(n=5) # 1 hub + 4 spokes # Returns node count graph.count_nodes() ``` ::: {.cell-output .cell-output-display execution_count=1} ``` 5 ``` ::: ::: ::: {#245f164c .cell execution_count=2} ``` {.python .cell-code} # Returns edge count graph.count_edges() ``` ::: {.cell-output .cell-output-display execution_count=2} ``` 4 ``` ::: :::
